description: Schema for a single IOC. Beamline values.yaml files reference #/definitions/iocFields instead (via beamline.schema.json), which carries the same fields without requiring iocname/iocprefix.

iocFields.description: Every field an IOC entry may carry. Split out so a beamline values.yaml can reuse it for epicsConfiguration.iocs[] and for iocDefaults entries, which are partial IOCs and must not require iocname/iocprefix.

name.description: IOC name as written in a beamline values.yaml (epicsConfiguration.iocs[].name). The rendered single-IOC form uses 'iocname' instead; both are accepted here.

iocexit.description: Exit IOC after initialization. (debug and CI integration)

devgroup.description: Device family. LOAD-BEARING for the operator screens: epik8s-opi's Scripts/epik8sutil.py conf_to_dev() dispatches with an exact string compare (`devgroup == group`, where group is the panel's GROUP macro) and builds the item widget path as uni<devgroup>-opi/<devgroup>_channel_load.bob. A devgroup that doesn't match a uni<x>-opi family means the device silently never appears on its panel.

devfunc.description: Device function within its family (e.g. a magnet's COR/QUA/DIP). Drives the FUNC filter on the operator panels. Declare it: when absent, epik8sutil.py conf_to_dev() falls back to guessing it from substrings of the device NAME (QUA*/DIP*/CHH*/CVV*/SLT*/FLG*/SIP*...), so any device not matching those naming conventions lands in the wrong filter bucket.

geo.description: Ordering position of the device along the beamline (monotonically increasing downstream). Used by downstream consumers (dashboard/synoptic ordering), not by any Jinja template. Not a calibrated s-coordinate in metres today - it is a relative ordering key.

iocroot.description: PV prefix for the IOC PVs.

asset.description: Optional asset/documentation link for the IOC as a whole. Not required: some IOCs track asset per-device instead (see devices[].asset), and some legitimately have none yet.

iocparam.description: generic IOC parameters to be replaced in the template.

ps.description: IOC-wide default power-supply rating/polarity block, overridable per device.

motor.description: IOC-wide default motor controller/axis configuration, overridable per device (devices[].<field> overrides field-by-field, not block-by-block). Shared by every motor devtype (pollux, pigcs2, newport, tml, technosoft-asyn, thorlabs, motorsim) - not every devtype consumes every field, see motor-schema.yaml's per-devtype table.

zones.description: Logical/physical zone grouping for this IOC (dashboard, interlock aggregation). A single zone name or a list of zone names.

limits.description: IOC-wide default alarm/display limits, overridable per device.

server.description: Default IP/hostname for this IOC's device connection.

port.description: Default TCP port for this IOC's device connection.

host.description: Target hostname for an SSH/SCP-deployed IOC (libera-llrf/libera-sppp style).

ip.description: IOC-level device IP, used by templates with a single fixed target.

workdir.description: Remote working directory for an SSH/SCP-deployed IOC.

exec.description: Entry script executed to start the IOC (e.g. st.cmd, start.sh).

start.description: Path to the start script for a bespoke softioc/epics-py-base IOC.

iocdir.description: Subdirectory within the IOC image/repo this IOC's config lives in.

iocbin.description: Path to the IOC binary, when it is not at the devtype's default location (see mrf-utca-300/mrf-pci-230, whose st.cmd.j2 shebang is #!{{iocbin}}).

image.description: Container image overriding the devtype's default.

charturl.description: Git URL of the ioc-chart (or other) Helm chart used to deploy this IOC.

gitinit.description: Whether to git-clone the IOC's scripts/config repo at container init.

autosync.description: Restart the IOC automatically when its rendered config changes.

disable.description: Skip deploying this IOC/service without removing its definition.

usegateway.description: Route this IOC's PVs through the CA/PVA gateway.

enable_ingress.description: Expose this IOC/service via an Ingress.

set_tolerance.description: Power-supply setpoint tolerance. Devices may override this IOC-level default.

zero_tolerance.description: Power-supply zero-current tolerance. Devices may override this IOC-level default.

set_timeout_s.description: Power-supply setpoint timeout in seconds. Devices may override this IOC-level default.

init_timeout_s.description: Power-supply initialization timeout in seconds. Devices may override this IOC-level default.

poll_state.description: Enable power-supply state polling (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

poll_state_interval.description: Power-supply state polling interval in seconds.

poll_analog.description: Enable power-supply analog polling (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

poll_analog_interval.description: Power-supply analog polling interval in seconds.

description.description: Free-text description of this IOC, distinct from the rendered template's own 'description:' header.

opi.description: Default OPI (.bob) screen for this IOC's devices.

scan.description: EPICS SCAN rate string (e.g. '.2 second'), used by bergoz-bcm.

active_poll_s.description: OCEM/E642 controller active poll period, in seconds.

active_timeout_s.description: OCEM/E642 controller active-state timeout, in seconds.

idle_poll_s.description: OCEM/E642 controller idle poll period, in seconds.

configFile.description: Controller-specific axis config/init file path (pollux, mercury/pigcs2).

yesNoRefFlag.description: PI GCS2 (pigcs2) referencing behavior flag, IOC-level default.

correction.description: OCEM modbus correction factor, IOC-level default.

correctionset.description: OCEM modbus correction set index, IOC-level default.

pump.description: Vacuum pump interlock thresholds monitored by an rf-conditioning softIOC.

scpoptions.description: Extra scp flags for an SSH/SCP-deployed IOC's file transfer.

ssh_options.description: Extra ssh flags for an SSH/SCP-deployed IOC's remote connection.

ssh_nodeport.description: NodePort exposing SSH to an embedded IOC target.

initcmd.description: Shell command run before the IOC starts on an SSH/SCP-deployed target (e.g. remounting rw).

networks.description: Multus secondary network attachments for this IOC (e.g. GigE Vision camera networks).

runon.description: Node-affinity-style placement hints, shaped like networks (name/annotation).

resources.description: Kubernetes resources block (limits/requests). Shape owned by the deploying chart.

securityContext.description: Kubernetes securityContext block. Shape owned by the deploying chart.

service.description: Extra Kubernetes Service configuration (e.g. adcamera's service.http.port for the MJPEG stream). Shape owned by the deploying chart.

alias.description: Display name substituted for this IOC's name on operator panels.

stream_enable.description: adcamera/adcamera2: enable the ffmpegServer MJPEG stream.

id.description: IOC-level device id, used as a single-device shorthand instead of devices[] (e.g. smc/polyscience chiller's DEV_ID).

iocfunc.description: mrf-pci-230: the *_registerRecordDeviceDriver function name for this build (e.g. 'elinp_gp06_ioc01'), when it differs from the devtype default.

nfsMounts.description: Per-IOC NFS/CIFS mounts, overriding/extending the beamline-level nfsMounts.

dataVolume.description: PersistentVolumeClaim request for this IOC's writable data directory. Shape owned by the deploying chart.

pls_width_max.description: scandinova-scandicat-mod: pulse-width HOPR (-> PLS_WDTH_SP_HOPR), IOC-level default.

i_max.description: scandinova-scandicat-mod: filament PS current HOPR (-> FILPS_CURR_SP_HOPR), IOC-level default.

pres_warn.description: scandinova-scandicat-mod: ion pump pressure MINOR alarm threshold (-> IONPMP_HIGH).

pres_alarm.description: scandinova-scandicat-mod: ion pump pressure MAJOR alarm threshold (-> IONPMP_HIHI).

value.description: Value of the parameter. Any scalar is valid - the Jinja templates interpolate it as {{value}}, string-typing it in the schema was stricter than actual usage (iocparam/iocinit routinely carry numbers and booleans, e.g. port: 4001, value: true).

channel.description: Channel identifier of the device. Integer for a plain channel index (icpdas, tektronix, ...); string for a devtype with an enum-style channel label instead (e.g. pfeiffer tpg300/tpg366: A1/A2/B1/B2, per the pfeiffer.tpg300 ibek-support channel entity).

asset.description: Optional asset/documentation link for this device. Not required - used instead of (or alongside) the IOC-level asset for IOCs that manage several distinct physical assets (e.g. one camera IOC with several devices[], each with its own asset link).

ps.description: Per-device power-supply rating/polarity block. Overrides any IOC-level ps: block field-by-field.

zones.description: Logical/physical zone grouping for this device. Consumers merge this with the IOC-level zones rather than replacing it (epik8s-opi appends the IOC zone to the device's own).

devfunc.description: Per-device function, overriding the IOC-level devfunc. Read by epik8s-opi's conf_to_dev() to populate the FUNC panel filter.

geo.description: Ordering position of this device along the beamline. Per-device is the common case (one IOC often drives several magnets at different positions).

limits.description: Per-device alarm/display limits, overriding any IOC-level limits field-by-field.

alias.description: Display name substituted for 'name' on the operator panels (epik8s-opi conf_to_dev uses dev.alias in place of dev.name when present).

prefix.description: Per-device PV prefix, overriding the IOC-level iocprefix. Honoured by epik8s-opi and by the motor/ps/mrf/libera templates.

opi.description: Per-device OPI (.bob) override, taking precedence over the IOC-level opi on the operator panels.

axid.description: Motor axis number on the controller. Per-device, no IOC-level default (each axis is distinct).

poi.description: Named points of interest (motor positions) for this axis.

velo.description: Motor axis default/max velocity. Overrides motor.velo.

vbas.description: Motor axis base velocity. Overrides motor.vbas.

accl.description: Motor axis acceleration time (s). Overrides motor.accl.

bdst.description: Motor axis backlash distance. Overrides motor.bdst.

bvel.description: Motor axis backlash velocity. Overrides motor.bvel.

bacc.description: Motor axis backlash acceleration time (s). Overrides motor.bacc.

ares.description: Motor axis actuator resolution (ARES). Optional: overrides motor.ares; when neither is set the axis mres is used.

prec.description: Motor axis display precision. Overrides motor.prec.

egu.description: Motor axis engineering units. Overrides motor.egu.

dir.description: Motor axis direction sense. Overrides motor.dir.

dllm.description: Motor axis dial low limit. Overrides motor.dllm.

dhlm.description: Motor axis dial high limit. Overrides motor.dhlm.

home.description: Motor axis homing direction/procedure flag (devtype-specific encoding). Overrides motor.home.

start.description: Motor axis homing start offset (devtype-specific). Overrides motor.start.

twv.description: Motor axis tweak step value. Overrides motor.twv.

server.description: Per-device IP/hostname, overriding the IOC-level server.

port.description: Per-device TCP port, overriding the IOC-level port.

ip.description: Per-device IP address (danfysik_hallprobes and similar templates read dev.ip specifically, not dev.server).

id.description: Device identifier. String for adcamera (IP address or hostname) and smc/polyscience (DEV_ID); integer for the ocem/danfysik/hazemeyer PS templates (slave/channel address).

set_timeout_s.description: Per-device power-supply setpoint timeout in seconds.

init_timeout_s.description: Per-device power-supply initialization timeout in seconds.

poll_state.description: Per-device state-polling enable flag (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

poll_state_interval.description: Per-device state polling interval in seconds.

poll_analog.description: Per-device analog-polling enable flag (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

poll_analog_interval.description: Per-device analog polling interval in seconds.

serial.description: Vendor serial number identifying this specific unit (e.g. PTU meteo station).

bus.description: PCI bus identifier for an MRF card (e.g. '06').

slot.description: PCI slot identifier for an MRF card (e.g. '00').

func.description: PCI function identifier for an MRF card (e.g. '0').

pv.description: An externally-defined PV this device references (bespoke softIOC glue, e.g. ioc-time-profile).

enablepv.description: PV that gates this device's activity (tektronix measurement channels).

nocheckconn.description: Skip connection-liveness checking for this device (chiller/smc).

interlock.description: This device participates in a vacuum/PS interlock. See the schema-consistency note on 'zones': it names the group, not the relationship - what it gates is not yet expressed here.

desc.description: Short description, used as the EPICS DESC field default on several templates.

correction.description: OCEM modbus correction factor for this device.

correctionset.description: OCEM modbus correction set index for this device.

buffers.description: Number of frame buffers to allocate (adcamera/adcamera2).

hihi.description: MAJOR alarm upper threshold, read directly (icpdas rtd). Equivalent to limits.hihi; the icpdas template reads this flat field, not the nested limits: block.

high.description: MINOR alarm upper threshold, read directly (icpdas rtd). See hihi.

low.description: MINOR alarm lower threshold, read directly (icpdas rtd). See hihi.

lolo.description: MAJOR alarm lower threshold, read directly (icpdas rtd). See hihi.

hvel.description: TML motor per-axis homing velocity, overriding motor.hvel.

jvel.description: TML motor per-axis jog velocity, overriding motor.jvel.

velo_max.description: TML motor per-axis maximum velocity, overriding motor.velo_max.

tcauto.description: agilent-vac xgs600 img sensor: thermocouple auto-range channel id.

axisId.description: technosoft-asyn per-axis id, alternative spelling to axid (the template checks axisId first, then axid, then falls back to the loop index).

setupFile.description: technosoft-asyn per-axis .t.zip setup file, overriding motor.setupFile.

homingSwitch.description: technosoft-asyn per-axis homing switch (e.g. LSN/LSP), overriding motor.homingSwitch.

buffer.description: mrf-pci-230 m9210: per-device sample buffer size.

eventpv.description: mrf-pci-230 m9210: PV suffix for the event counter.

ps.description: Power-supply rating, control mode and polarity behavior, shared by every PS devtype under devgroup: mag (ocem/E642, danfysik/sys8x00, maccaferriPS, psEEI/eei, caenels/{fastps,easydriver,histar}, hazemeyer, sigmaphi, ibilt/biltitest).

polarity.description: Physical polarity behavior of the supply.

mode.description: unipolar: fixed to one sign, requires 'sign'. bipolar-native: true four-quadrant, signed setpoint direct. bipolar-switched: monopolar hardware + polarity relay, requires 'switch'. unspecified: polarity behavior not yet confirmed against hardware - MUST NOT be treated as unipolar by consumers. This is the global default when polarity (or the whole ps: block) is omitted entirely - no PS devtype's Jinja template branches on the literal 'unspecified' string, so omitting it is behaviorally identical to writing it out. Only set mode explicitly once it's actually confirmed against the hardware.

sign.description: Required when mode == unipolar: which rail this supply is wired to.

settle_time_s.description: Dwell time in standby before/after the polarity relay flips, in seconds.

zero_threshold.description: |current| (or |voltage|, per control_mode) below which it is safe to flip the polarity relay.

control_mode.description: Which quantity is the regulated setpoint. The other block, if present, is a compliance limit only. Every PS devtype in this repo is current-regulated today, so 'current' is the global default when omitted - no need to repeat it in iocDefaults or on individual devices. Set explicitly only for a genuinely voltage-regulated PS.

min.description: Lower bound of the achievable envelope (symmetric bipolar: min = -max).

max.description: Upper bound of the achievable envelope.

ramp.description: Rate-of-change limit. null = not ramp-limited or not applicable.

limit.description: Additional software safety clamp layered on top of min/max (devtype-specific; seen on caenels as IMAX/OMAX). null/0 conventionally means disabled for devtypes that support it.

zones.description: A single zone name, or a list of zone names. Both forms are in active use across facilities; consumers must accept either. NOTE for consumers: an IOC-level zones and a device-level zones can EACH independently be a string or a list - do not assume the device-level one is a list before merging the IOC-level one into it (see epik8s-opi Scripts/epik8sutil.py conf_to_dev, which normalizes both).

devgroup.description: Controlled vocabulary for the device family. Three vocabularies must agree for a device to reach its operator panel: this field, the GROUP macro a .bob panel passes, and the uni<x>-opi directory name (epik8sutil.conf_to_dev does `devgroup == group`, then builds uni<GROUP>-opi/<GROUP>_channel_load.bob). Only six values line up on all three today: mag, mot, vac, cam, cool, io. KNOWN MISMATCHES, devices in these groups are NOT reachable from any panel until one side is renamed: 'diag' (panels pass GROUP=daq), 'timing' (panels pass GROUP=tim), 'modulator' (the directory is unimod-opi, i.e. 'mod', and no panel passes either spelling), 'bpm' (unibpm-opi exists but no panel passes GROUP=bpm), 'rf' (no uni<x>-opi family and no panel at all). Synonyms that are NOT accepted: 'motor' (use 'mot'), 'cooling' (use 'cool'), 'vpc'/'vgc' (use 'vac' and put the pump/gauge distinction in devfunc). 'mps' (machine protection, ssrip-mps template) and 'saf' (safety PLC I/O, plceli template) are also accepted - like diag/rf/timing, neither has a uni<x>-opi panel yet.

devfunc.description: Device function within its devgroup. These are exactly the values epik8s-opi's conf_to_dev() produces - declared values win over its name-substring guessing. mag: COR (corrector), QUA (quadrupole), DIP (dipole/bend), SOL (solenoid), SEX (sextupole), UFS (fast corrector). mot: SLT (slit), FLG (flag/screen), MIR (mirror), HMOT/VMOT (horizontal/vertical stage), MOT (generic). vac: ion (ion pump), pig (Pirani/penning gauge), ccg (cold cathode gauge), turbo (turbomolecular pump), scroll (scroll/backing pump).

limits.description: EPICS alarm/display limits for this device's main readback, so alarm thresholds live with the device definition instead of only in the Phoebus alarm tree. Generalizes the hihi/high/low/lolo fields that templates/io/icpdas already accepts per RTD channel.

egu.description: Engineering units for the limits above.

motor.description: Motor controller/axis configuration shared by every motor devtype (pollux, pigcs2, newport, tml, technosoft-asyn, thorlabs, motorsim). See motor-schema.yaml for the per-devtype field table - not every devtype reads every field below, and fields it doesn't read are simply ignored rather than rejected.

movingPollPeriod.description: Poll period while an axis is moving (s).

idlePollPeriod.description: Poll period while an axis is idle (s).

configFile.description: Path to a controller-specific axis config/init file (pollux, mercury/pigcs2).

sendVelAccel.description: Whether to push velocity/acceleration to the controller at init (pollux).

eguxstep.description: EGU-per-step conversion used to seed controller EGU scaling (pollux, newport).

motorType.description: Thorlabs stage family - selects the template's built-in per-type default envelope (velo/mres/dhlm/...).

velo.description: IOC-wide default axis velocity, applied to every device unless overridden on devices[].

bacc.description: IOC-wide default axis backlash acceleration time (s).

ares.description: IOC-wide default axis actuator resolution (ARES). When unset each axis falls back to its own mres.

dllm.description: IOC-wide default axis dial low limit.

dhlm.description: IOC-wide default axis dial high limit.

home.description: IOC-wide default axis homing direction/procedure flag (devtype-specific encoding).

start.description: IOC-wide default axis homing start offset (devtype-specific).

twv.description: IOC-wide default axis tweak step value.

networkEntry.description: A Multus secondary network attachment for this IOC.

dayAccumulator.description: Daily charge/value accumulator, used by the tektronix template's day_accumulators.

pumpEntry.description: A vacuum pump interlock threshold, used by the bespoke rf-conditioning softIOCs' pump list.

modbusRegister.description: A single Modbus register exposed by modbus-generic.

r.description: Record name suffix override, defaults to ':'+name.

modbusSlave.description: A Modbus slave device on a modbus-generic connection.

modbusConnection.description: A Modbus TCP connection carrying one or more slaves (modbus-generic template).

ptty.description: Local pseudo-tty device the serial bridge is exposed on.

nfsMountEntry.description: An NFS/CIFS mount made available inside the IOC container.

path.description: Remote path exported by the server.

mountPath.description: Path the export is mounted at inside the container.

type.description: Filesystem type, when not the chart's default (e.g. 'cifs').
